sam k: Quick triage: onboarding nova-13b-int3 shows a small rerank drop concentrated on long-dialog anchors. Suspects: golden refresh introduced near-duplicates + int3 tail clipping. @li zhang @zoe can we smoke?
li zhang: Running a 1k-sample dedupe focused on long turns with tokenwalk-v2, threshold=0.93. ETA 12m. Cmd: `python infra/tools/dedupe.py --input s3://redwood/golden/refresh --out /tmp/golden-dedupe --min-sim 0.93`
zoe: I paused the auto-refresh and exported the candidate shard. Found 16 fuzzy dupes in a quick pass, saved them to s3://redwood/golden/dupes/1769301212.csv.
anya: I'll run a focused int3 mini-calib on the 1k dedup slice to compare logits tails vs fp32. If clipping is the cause we can try activation_clip=0.025.
labelops-bot: relabel job queued by zoe  job_id=9922, samples=120, priority=high.
sam k: Good — plan: finish dedupe, run mini-calib, relabel ambiguous anchors, then run 5-seed rerank harness. Keep updates here.
